title: nan
authors: Ye Q.; Luo J.; Lin Y.
key_contribution: Presents a coarse-to-fine visual geo-localization method for GNSS-denied UAVs using oblique-view imagery and orthographic references, validated on public and self-collected datasets.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
